notes:
Account background: mid-market B2B SaaS (customer success/product analytics). Evaluating LLM features for in-app support assistant + semantic search across 2M docs. Initial ask: low-latency chat (sub-300ms target p95), embeddings for search, reranking to improve top-k relevance.

Sales/Intro calls: 2026-01-18 intro (Anika) — product + compliance overview. Customer quote: 'we need predictable cost at scale — can't have runaway token bills.' Interested first in Hosted API to ship quickly, then move to Dedicated for cost predictability and data isolation.

POC approach: Hosted API spike completed (Jan) to validate quality and integration. Current phase: evaluation of Dedicated sizing and explicit cost tradeoffs. Ran two internal experiments with hosted API:
- small-batch (1-2) baseline -> latency ok but high per-token cost
- workload-aware batching (server-side) + prefix caching -> cost down ~35%, slight p95 increase (~+30ms)

Cost optimization workshop (3/02): ran 90m session with Diego + infra team. Covered batching window tuning, auto-prefix caching, and quantization profiles (int8 vs 4-bit). Outcomes:
- Quantization: 8-bit yields 20-30% CPU/GPU throughput gain with small quality impact; 4-bit shows more savings but requires eval on core prompt set.
- Batching: recommended dynamic batching during low-latency paths and smaller batch sizes for interactive flows.
- Unit economics model: built PoC spreadsheet showing break-even at ~600k tokens/day for Dedicated.

Security/compliance: SSO/SAML required, audit logs and KMS mandatory. Data residency: want EU region for EU customers; Redwood region routing is a must. Legal: DPA review in legal (blocker).

Open questions / risks:
- Precise Dedicated sizing for peak day vs steady state — infra wants clearer traffic envelope.
- Quantization quality regressions on long-form summarization (customer to run evals).
- Procurement timeline: finance needs pricing with 12- and 36-month committed tiers.

Next steps (agreed on call):
1) Deliver Dedicated sizing + cost model (Redwood to provide 2 sizing options: conservative and optimized with aggressive batching/quant).
2) Follow-up workshop to run 4-bit quantization eval against WWQ prompt set (SE + WWQ ML team).
3) Legal: send updated DPA and security FAQ (Anika -> legal contact).
4) Set pilot start date: target 2026-04-15 for a 6-week Dedicated POC.

- AE: "good traction, CFO cares about unit economics"
- SE: "need traffic percentiles for week-of-month spikes"
- Customer: "don't compromise relevance for cost — reranking precision is critical"
